# e-Comet - Full automation of promotion on Wildberries

> An effective tool for managing online advertising, analyzing trends, and finding profitable niches on Wildberries

## Pages
- [Home](https://e-comet.io/): Bidder and advertising management, photo A/B tests, the MCP plugin for AI assistants, pricing and contacts.

## Knowledge Base
- [Overview](https://e-comet.io/docs): Description of the e-Comet platform and its features for advertising management and analytics on Wildberries.
- [Portfolio](https://e-comet.io/docs/portfolio): Product analytics, comparison metrics, 30-day trends.
- [Legal entities and API tokens](https://e-comet.io/docs/account/tokens): Adding legal entities, obtaining and configuring API tokens.
- [Subscription management](https://e-comet.io/docs/account/subscription): Managing subscription status and plan settings.
- [Employees and access rights](https://e-comet.io/docs/account/staff): Adding team members and setting permissions.
- [Notifications](https://e-comet.io/docs/account/notification): Configuring alerts via email or Telegram (e.g. token expiry, subscription renewal).
- [FAQ](https://e-comet.io/docs/account/faq): Frequently asked questions about account settings.
- [Overview](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/autopilot/overview): General description of the autopilot feature.
- [Getting Started](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/autopilot/start): How to begin using autopilot.
- [Settings](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/autopilot/settings): Parameters, thresholds, and configuration.
- [Statistics](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/autopilot/stats): Performance metrics under autopilot.
- [Pricing](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/autopilot/pricing): Cost structure and limits for autopilot.
- [FAQ](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/autopilot/faq): Common questions about autopilot.
- [Getting Started](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/start): How to create and launch campaigns.
- [Type Auto](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/auto): Automatic campaign type.
- [Type Auction](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/auction): Auction-type campaigns (search only).
- [Creation](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/create): Campaign creation workflow.
- [Settings](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/settings): Configuring targeting, bids, and budgets.
- [Statuses](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/status): Campaign lifecycle statuses (active, paused, etc.).
- [Clusters](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/preset): Grouping phrases into clusters.
- [PRO Features](https://e-comet.io/docs/ad/campaigns/pro): Advanced functionality available with PRO.
- [Overview](https://e-comet.io/docs/ab-tests/overview): General description of A/B testing.
- [Getting Started](https://e-comet.io/docs/ab-tests/start): How to set up and launch a test.
- [Settings](https://e-comet.io/docs/ab-tests/settings): Parameters and configuration options.
- [Statistics](https://e-comet.io/docs/ab-tests/stats): Interpreting test results and metrics.
- [FAQ](https://e-comet.io/docs/ab-tests/faq): Frequently asked questions about A/B testing.
- [Phrases](https://e-comet.io/docs/phrases): Popular search queries, tracking of organic and promo positions.
- [Feed](https://e-comet.io/docs/lenta): Real-time order stream with returns and cancellations.
- [Overview](https://e-comet.io/docs/feedbacks/start): How to start working with feedbacks.
- [Tables](https://e-comet.io/docs/tools/sheets): Features for working with tables, sorting, and exports.
- [Filters](https://e-comet.io/docs/tools/filter): Advanced filters for managing data in tables and lists.
- [Browser Extension](https://e-comet.io/docs/tools/extension): Chrome extension with quick access to e-Comet features.
- [Glossary](https://e-comet.io/docs/glossary): Key terms and metrics used in the system.
- [Pricing](https://e-comet.io/docs/tariffs): Subscription plans, PRO features, and limitations.
- [Referral Program](https://e-comet.io/docs/referral): Information about the partner and referral program.
- [Support](https://e-comet.io/docs/support): Help center and support contacts.
